not_found.why: The quarterly report prints no CSM roll-forward: only segment CSM balances at 1.1.2024, 30.9.2024 and 31.12.2024 (Note 14) and the retention (net) totals at 1.1.2025, 1.7.2025 and 30.9.2025 (board report). No movement rows in the CSM, so no bridge.
Segment CSM balances at 30.9.2025 are not printed; only the retention total of 10,323 (board report).
No 30.9.2025 risk adjustment balances printed; only the Note 14 balances for 2024 dates.
Loss component balances not printed; only losses on onerous contracts in Note 7.
Annualized new-business premiums for life and health not printed; only investment-contract new business.
No total P&C combined ratio; only the combined ratio for motor property.
Provident AUM appears only in a pie chart on Hebrew p10 without an unambiguous series mapping.
No dividend declared after the balance sheet date is reported.
Latest solvency ratio printed is as of 30.6.2025; no 30.9.2025 ratio.
